trap2Result.derivation: scan the comment-stripped served scripts for id-writing expressions: `.id =`, setAttribute("id", ...), and id=" inside a template literal. Recomputed every run; nothing is hand-declared.
trap2Result.positiveBasis: web/app.js makes 13 document.createElement calls and sets className, textContent and dataset on them. It assigns .id on none and calls setAttribute only with aria-selected and aria-expanded. So every one of the 70 addressed ids must exist in the static document and nothing is excused. This is a positive determination, not an empty result: the test asserts the derivation returns no id-writing FORMS, and separately asserts the createElement population is non-zero so the emptiness is a fact about the code rather than about the extractor.
